title: Israeli strike kills seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in central Gaza
body:
On the evening of 1 April 2024, an Israeli strike hit a convoy of the aid charity World Central Kitchen (WCK) in the Gaza Strip. WCK said seven of its workers were killed. The group said the victims came from Australia, Poland, the United Kingdom, Palestine, and one dual United States-Canadian citizen. Hospital staff reported that passports of the dead indicated one British, one Australian and one Polish national, and other reports said a Palestinian driver was also among the dead.

WCK said the convoy was travelling in a deconflicted zone and was leaving a warehouse in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, where it had unloaded food aid. The charity said its movements had been coordinated with the Israeli military. An Associated Press medic reported that the team had been delivering aid in northern Gaza and was heading south toward Rafah. WCK announced early on 2 April 2024 that it was pausing its aid operations in the region.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu acknowledged what he called an unintentional hit by Israeli forces on innocent people, saying that this happens in war, and pledged to do everything to prevent a repeat. The Israeli military said it was investigating at the highest levels, and its spokesperson, Rear Admiral Daniel Hagari, said the findings would be shared transparently. Governments of several of the victims' countries called for accountability.
